BiblicalUsage: Hazarmaveth, the village of death, is the third son of Joktan in the table of nations, named in Genesis and again in the Chronicles genealogy. He founded a people of southern Arabia that became a province and a trading centre.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God tracks the nations from the beginning, even a son of Joktan whose name means death. Hazarmaveth is in the record because every nation comes from Noah's sons.
